# Lox trophy

Type: Trophy | Internal ID: TrophyLox | Source: Lox | Usage: Crafting, Decoration | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Lox trophy is a rare 10% drop rate item dropped by Lox.

### Crafting

• Misty fishing bait
• Bracelets of the Brave

### Misc

• Can be displayed in an Item stand.
• Can be used to program Ballistas.
